Feature: Register Read/Write and Reset Value Verification
Test Description: Validate the GPIO pad control register block by checking default reset values and verifying masked write/read behavior across pad registers 8 through 27. For readable locations, confirm reset values with input bit0 ignored. For writable locations, apply standard data patterns to writable bits and confirm readback matches the expected combination of written bits and preserved defaults on non-writable bits.

If def_fail_cnt > 0 or wr_fail_cnt > 0 → finish(1); else finish(0). chk_rst_val(): For i in [0..CNT-1]: addr=addr_array[i]; if (skip_rst_array[i]==1) continue; if (read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000) continue; data_rd=read_reg(addr); data=(data_rd & 0xFFFFFFFE); if (data==default_value_array[i]) PASS else { def_fail_cnt++; print failure with addr, expected, read }. chk_rd_wr(): Patterns chk_val[]={0xFFFFFFFF,0xAAAAAAAA,0x55555555,0xF5F5F5F5,0xA5A5A5A5,0xFFFF0000}. For each data_wr in chk_val: Write phase: for i in [0..CNT-1]: if (skip_array[i]==1) continue; if (write_mask_array[i]==0x00000000) continue; write_reg(addr_array[i], (data_wr & write_mask_array[i])). Read/verify phase: for i in [0..CNT-1]: if (skip_array[i]==1 || write_mask_array[i]==0x00000000 || read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000) continue; data_rd=(read_reg(addr_array[i]) & read_mask_array[i]); wr_n=(write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xFFFFFFFF); exp_val=((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); if (data_rd==exp_val) PASS else { wr_fail_cnt++; print mismatch with addr, expected, read }. soft_reset_chk() exists but is compiled out (#ifdef 0) and writes/reads SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS with SOFT_RST_REG_DATA when enabled.
Remarks: Default-value comparison ignores the least significant input bit to avoid false mismatches due to input behavior. Registers with no readable bits are skipped for reads; registers with no writable bits are skipped for writes and subsequent readback checks. Ensure the loop bound matches the array lengths to avoid out-of-bounds access.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Verify reset defaults for GPIO_8 to GPIO_27: for each readable register not marked to skip, read and compare against its documented default value with bit0 ignored. 2) For each standard test pattern, program each writable register’s writable bits and skip non-writable or skipped entries. 3) Read back each applicable register and verify the value equals the combination of the written pattern on writable bits and the preserved default on non-writable readable bits. 4) Report PASS only if all default checks and all pattern readbacks match their expected values; otherwise report FAIL.

Feature: Interrupt Falling Edge Detection and Servicing
Test Description: Validate that per-pin falling-edge interrupts on GPIO group are generated, latched, and serviced correctly. Enable the group output in system registers and GIC, configure per-pin control for falling-edge detection, enable each pin’s interrupt mask, generate a single falling edge on each pin, and verify per-pin and group status set/clear behavior along with system-level interrupt clearing.
Meta Test Description:
test_case(): Initialize test_err=0. Conditionally enable GIC IRQ (87 for GPIO0 or 88 for GPIO1). Enable system-level GPIO interrupt via INTR_EN1 for the selected GPIO block. Initialize external driver at 0xA0243ffc to 0xffffffff. For i=0..31: addr1=MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4); write_reg(addr1, (1u<<20)|(1u<<18)|(1u<<16)); wait_on(10). For i=0..31: wr_val=(1u<<i); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, wr_val); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, wr_val); wait_on(10); set int_pend=1; drive 0xA0243ffc to 0xffffffff then to ~wr_val to generate a falling edge on the selected pad; poll with timeout (5000*wait_on(10)) until int_pend cleared by ISR; on timeout, log error and increment test_err. finish(test_err).
Default_IRQHandler(): local_wr=(1u<<i); set int_pend=0; drive 0xA0243ffc to 0xffffffff. Read per-pin config rdata from MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4). If (rdata & 0x1) != 0 then error (unexpected DIN level). If ((rdata & 0x2) != 0x0) then: read rdata_grp from MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1; if ((rdata_grp & local_wr)==0) then error; write per-pin control at same address to (1u<<20)|(1u<<16) (clear/ack as needed); write MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1 with local_wr; read rdata_grp again; if non-zero then error. Clear system-level RAW_STCR1 for GPIO0 or GPIO1 and clear GIC IRQ (87/88). Else (if per-pin status bit not set) increment error.
Remarks: External pad stimulation is driven via address 0xA0243ffc to create falling edges. The test uses a timeout to avoid infinite wait if no interrupt arrives. Group selection depends on compile-time GPIO0/GPIO1 selection. Verification expects per-pin and group interrupt status to set on a falling edge and to clear after servicing. Ensure hardware routing from pads 8–39 to the group interrupt is active.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Enable the GPIO group interrupt output in the system interrupt enable register and enable the corresponding GIC IRQ. 2) Configure each GPIO pad control register to enable falling-edge detection and to clear any stale status. 3) For each GPIO pin in the group, clear its raw status and enable its group interrupt mask. 4) Generate a single falling edge on the targeted pin via the external stimulus and wait for the ISR to trigger within the timeout. 5) In the ISR, verify that the per-pin status indicates an edge was detected, confirm the group status bit is set for that pin, clear the per-pin raw status, confirm the group status is cleared, and clear the system-level interrupt output. 6) Repeat for all pins and declare pass only if no timeouts or status mismatches occur.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: Pass if for each GPIO pad in the group: a falling edge triggers the interrupt, the group interrupt status reflects the corresponding bit, the per-pin raw status can be cleared, subsequent reads show the group status cleared, and the system-level interrupt output is cleared. Any timeout waiting for the ISR or any status mismatch results in failure.

Test Description: Validate that enabling rising-edge detection on all GPIO pads produces group interrupts for each pad, that per-pin raw status is cleared correctly, group status deasserts after clear, and system-level outputs are cleared, with the group re-armed for subsequent pads.
Meta Test Description:
test_case(): Conditionally enable GIC IRQ (87 or 88). Initialize test_err=0. Enable system-level GPIO interrupt via INTR_EN1 for the selected GPIO block. For i=0..31: configure pad control at MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (i*4) to 0x00020000 (enable rising-edge). wait_on(10). Configure IO control groups GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1..4 to 0x000000FF. wait_on(10). Enable group interrupts: write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0xFFFFFFFF). For i=0..31: drive external 0xA0243ffc low (0x00000000); wait_on(10); set int_pend=1; drive 0xA0243ffc high (0xFFFFFFFF) to generate a rising edge; poll with timeout (2000*wait_on(10)) until ISR clears int_pend; on timeout, log error, increment test_err, and break. After each iteration, drive low again and wait. finish(test_err).
Default_IRQHandler(): wr_val=(1<<i); set int_pend=0. Read group status rdata_grp from MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1. Mask group output by writing 0x00000000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1. If rdata_grp has any bit set then success for this entry; else increment test_err. Clear per-pin raw status for all 32 pins by writing 0x00010000 to each MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (j*4). wait_on(2). Read rdata_grp again; expect 0x0 else increment test_err. Clear system-level RAW_STCR1 for the selected GPIO block (GPIO0/1) and verify status bit cleared by reading back. Re-enable INTR1_INTR_EN1 with 0xFFFFFFFF. Clear GIC IRQ (87/88).
Remarks: Rising edges are generated via external drive at 0xA0243ffc toggling low-to-high. IO control group registers are configured before enabling interrupts. The ISR masks group output during service, clears all per-pin raw statuses, verifies that group status is cleared, clears the system-level status, and re-enables the group for the next iteration. Ensure routing for pads 8–39 and external drive control are available.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Enable the GPIO group interrupt output in system registers and enable the GIC IRQ. 2) Configure each GPIO pad control register to enable rising-edge detection. 3) Configure the GPIO IO control group registers as required for input operation. 4) Enable the group interrupt mask for all pads. 5) For each pad, generate a single rising edge using the external driver, and wait for the ISR within the timeout. 6) In the ISR, confirm that the group status indicates an interrupt occurred, clear all per-pin raw statuses, verify the group status is cleared, clear the system-level status output, and re-enable the group mask. 7) Repeat for all pads; test passes only if no timeouts or status mismatches occur.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: For each pad, a rising edge must assert the group interrupt status. The per-pin raw statuses must be clearable via the pad control registers, the group interrupt status must read as 0 after clear, and the system interrupt output must be cleared. Any timeout waiting for the ISR or any residual status after clear results in failure.
